data.title: Guardian of the Digital Order
data.narrative_purpose: Establish Elena's character as a highly capable cybersecurity analyst, deeply embedded in and trusting of the digital systems she oversees for OmniCorp.
data.camera_style: Open on static wide, slow push into close-up on Elena, then tight on her eyes reflecting screens.
data.color_palette: Muted grays, clinical whites, cool blues from screens
data.lighting: Harsh overhead fluorescent, screen glow as primary light source
data.visual_motif: Reflections in screens, geometric office architecture, data streams
sound_effects: Precise, rhythmic clicks of a mechanical keyboard

data.title: The First Glitch
data.narrative_purpose: Introduce the initial, minor digital inconsistency in Elena's personal records, which she confidently dismisses as a simple system error.
data.camera_style: Tight close-ups on screen displaying data, intercut with Elena's face reflecting the screen's glow.
data.color_palette: Dominant screen blue, sterile office whites
data.visual_motif: Highlighted data fields, digital text, reflections
data.music: Low ambient drone with a subtle, brief dissonant shift

data.title: The Digital Erasure Begins
data.narrative_purpose: Illustrate the escalating and systematic nature of the digital alterations to Elena's identity, shifting her from confident analyst to frantic investigator, culminating in a disturbing discovery of altered personal history.
data.emotion: Growing unease, paranoia, frantic energy, unsettling
data.location: OmniCorp Headquarters - Elena Vasquez's Office / Elena's Apartment - Home Office
data.camera_style: Dynamic montage of rapid cuts between screens and Elena's face. Handheld in apartment, close-ups on details.
data.color_palette: Shifting from cool blue/sickly green (office) to warmer but stark apartment tones, dominated by screen light.
data.lighting: Corporate: harsh overhead, sickly green screen glow. Apartment: flickering screen light, practical lamps casting deep shadows.
data.visual_motif: Overwritten data, disappearing details, digital blur, reflections of a changing identity
data.music: High-pitched whine building in intensity, distorted electronic layers

data.title: Identity Not Found
data.narrative_purpose: Deliver the climax of the section, depicting Elena's ultimate digital erasure and the profound horror of realizing her entire identity has been systematically dismantled by the system she trusted.
data.camera_style: Extreme close-up on Elena's face, slow push-in, static shot on the stark 'IDENTITY NOT FOUND' message.
data.color_palette: Harsh, cold blue from monitor, deep shadows in the background
data.lighting: Solely screen light, casting stark, cold illumination on her face
data.visual_motif: Stark text on screen, reflections of despair, empty digital space
data.music: Abrupt silence, followed by a slowly building, deep, ominous thrum
